limitations: Initial concurrent UDP had one missing 512-byte Linux-to-Windows 2022 echo; larger repeat had one missing 1400-byte echo in each Windows-to-Windows direction. Cause remains unestablished.
UDP-only repeat received all 300 echoes; this does not establish that concurrent TCP caused the earlier losses.
Image is pulled from a private test ECR repository using expiring pull credentials; no VM image preloading or fresh CAPI worker boot qualification.
Restart tests stop Felix through CRI, not the worker VM or worker service.
No sustained throughput, full policy matrix, periodic drift repair, gateway failover, GPU or release qualification.
